description: Which of the 8 conceptual integrity-validation levels are CURRENT vs. NOT_EXECUTED, confirmed by inspecting backend/jewelmind/exporters/integrity.py and services/model_service.py during Sprint 7.

vectors.message: Checked by validate_non_empty() (Sprint 7 addition), which raises ArtifactIntegrityError if the path does not exist.
validate_non_empty() also rejects a zero-byte file.
The extension is appended by the API layer (sanitize_filename() + '.step'), never independently verified against the actual file content.
The MIME type in the HTTP response is a fixed literal ('application/step'), never derived from or checked against the actual file bytes.
sha256_checksum() (Sprint 7 addition), exposed via the X-Content-SHA256 response header.
binary_stl_triangle_count() (Sprint 7 addition) reads and validates the binary STL header structure (84-byte header + N*50-byte triangles) matches the file size exactly.
No ISO-10303 header signature check exists.

backend/tests/test_export_integrity.py::test_step_export_roundtrip_via_reimport re-imports via cadquery.importers.importStep() — but this runs only in the test suite, NOT at runtime for every real export request.
The same test compares re-imported solid count and volume (within a 1e-3 relative tolerance) against the original GeneratedModel — test-time only, not runtime.

Not applicable in the same sense — JSON export is validated by re-parsing and comparing to the original definition, which IS tested (test_api.py::test_export_json_matches_original_definition), but this is a different kind of check than geometric roundtrip.

runtimeVsTestOnly: Every PASS above marked with 'test suite' in its message is TEST-TIME ONLY — it does not run for a real user's export request. The only checks that run for every real export request are FILE_EXISTENCE, NON_ZERO_SIZE (both via validate_non_empty()), and CHECKSUM (via sha256_checksum(), always computed and returned in the response header).
